steps.title: Maintain stocks and generate genotypes
steps.instruction: Rear all Drosophila stocks at 25 °C on standard cornmeal‑molasses diet with a 12 h light/12 h dark cycle; keep 50–60 adult flies per vial and transfer to fresh vials every 2–3 days. Generate experimental genotypes by crossing: (a) Myo1A‑GAL4/CyO;UAS‑GFP,tub‑Gal80 ts/TM6B females with Oregon‑R males to obtain Myo ts > GFP; (b) Myo ts females with Cat n1 mutant males to obtain Myo ts > GFP + Cat n1; (c) Myo ts females with UAS‑hr96‑Ri (#330288 or #10958) males to obtain Myo ts > GFP + hr96Ri. House all experimental flies at 22 °C until adulthood.

steps.title: Age flies for experimental groups
steps.instruction: Transfer 1‑day‑old Myo ts > GFP flies to 29 °C for 45 days to induce aging. Transfer 1‑day‑old Myo ts > GFP + Cat n1 and Myo ts > GFP + hr96Ri flies to 29 °C for 10 days to induce age‑related (catalase mutant) conditions.

steps.title: Feed flies vitamin D
steps.instruction: Prepare standard food containing 100 nM 1α,25‑dihydroxyvitamin D3 (VitD). Treat 3‑day‑old Myo ts > GFP, Myo ts > GFP + Cat n1, Myo ts > GFP + hr96Ri (or 38‑day‑old Myo ts > GFP) with this food for 7 days at 29 °C in the dark, transferring flies to fresh vials every 2 days.

steps.title: Dissect intact midguts
steps.instruction: Anesthetize adult flies with CO₂, remove heads with forceps, grasp thorax and gently pull the posterior abdomen to extract the intact midgut (crop to rectum) in a hole slide glass containing 1× PBS. Place ten whole guts into a 1.5 mL microtube with 1× PBS on ice and proceed immediately to fixation.

steps.title: Fix and dehydrate gut samples
steps.instruction: Fix guts for 30 min in 4 % paraformaldehyde (PFA) prepared in 1× PBS on a single orbital shaker in the dark. Dehydrate sequentially for 5 min each in 50 %, 75 %, 87.5 % and 100 % methanol (all containing 4 % PFA in 1× PBS). Rehydrate for 5 min each in 50 %, 25 % and 12.5 % methanol prepared in 1× PBST (PBS + 0.1 % Triton X‑100). Wash three times, 20 min each, with 1× PBST (use 800 µL per wash unless otherwise noted).

steps.title: Perform immunostaining
steps.instruction: Incubate samples overnight at 4 °C in 1× PBST containing primary antibodies: anti‑PH3 (1:1000), anti‑γ‑tubulin (1:1000) and anti‑GFP (1:1000). Wash three times, 20 min each, with 1× PBST. Incubate at 25 °C for 1 h in 1× PBST with the appropriate secondary antibodies and DAPI (1:1000). Wash again three times, 20 min each, with 1× PBST.

steps.title: Mount and image samples
steps.instruction: Mount stained guts using Vectashield. Image the whole midgut with an Axioskop 2 Plus microscope and count PH3⁺ cells that contain ≤2 or ≥3 centrosomes.
